name: Von 1.2
author: wfzyx (independent)
head: Option-Marker head: every candidate option gets a [MASK] marker scored by a small head; in v1.2 an option's tokens attend only to the shared premise and its own tokens, positions restart per option, making each option's logit a function of (premise, that option) alone
objective: 1.2 was retrained from the 1.1 weights under the new order-invariant attention mask and recovers 1.1's accuracy on every public tier
primitives: choice-style decisions (declared options scored in one pass); noul with a fitted context-free prior correction
calibration_as_shipped: On JevBench public items (ece_top_label): easy tier accuracy 100.0%/ECE 0.109, standard 63.9%/ECE 0.045, hard 36.9%/ECE 0.089; map fitted in-sample on the 231 public items, split-half validation gives Calibration axis 67.6 vs in-sample 77.4
latency: not disclosed as a ms figure in the portion of the card fetched

head: Shared candidate head reads candidate endpoints and the final query vector; each question uses one forward pass, questions run independently in batches of eight
